label: Forest
description: Forest interiors as hero subjects — season and succession readable in the trees.

items.name: redwood-cathedral
items.text: a cathedral grove of coastal redwoods in summer fog, the crowns combing water from the air to drip-feed their own roots, fire-blackened hollows healed over in living bark

items.name: beech-bluebells
items.text: a spring beech wood floored wall-to-wall with bluebells, flowering hard in the few weeks before the closing canopy takes the light, new leaves overhead still translucent lime

items.name: mossy-rainforest
items.text: temperate rainforest dripping after rain, every trunk sleeved in moss, ferns riding the branches, a fallen nurse log sprouting its own straight row of seedlings

items.name: birch-graphic
items.text: a graphic stand of white birch against dark undergrowth, papery bark peeling in horizontal curls, black branch scars ticking every trunk

items.name: autumn-larch
items.text: golden larch forest blazing against fresh early snow — the one conifer that drops its needles, turning whole mountainsides amber for a two-week window

items.name: bamboo-sea
items.text: a rolling sea of bamboo swaying in green waves, polished culms clacking hollow where they cross, light strobing down the aisles between them

items.name: jungle-buttress
items.text: giant buttress roots fanning like ship keels from a rainforest emergent, thin wooden walls bracing a canopy giant rooted in a hand-span of soil

items.name: pine-snowload
items.text: boreal spruce bowed under thick pillows of snowload, their narrow spire crowns built to shed it, the silence deep enough to hear a branch unload

items.name: olive-ancients
items.text: ancient olive trees on terraced red earth, trunks twisted into hollow silver rope by a thousand harvests, this year's leaves still grey-green and full

items.name: burned-regrowth
items.text: a burned forest one summer on, charred spars standing over a waist-high flood of magenta fireweed, pine cones sprung open by the very heat that killed them

items.name: cloud-forest
items.text: a high cloud forest dripping in permanent mist, every branch upholstered in moss, orchids and hanging epiphytes

items.name: aspen-gold
items.text: an aspen grove turned uniform gold in one week, black-scarred white trunks — a single clonal organism changing color together
